submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 5.4 mm gives the best observed 100 GeV electron energy resolution in the simulation scan. Coarse scans showed F3 outperforming F1 and F2 across the relevant range: at 5 mm the simulation/documented values are about F3 3.2%, F1 about 3.9-4.1%, and F2 about 5.1-5.3%. A finer F3 scan around the optimum found the best observed value at 5.4 mm, with repeated simulations at 5.4 mm giving 3.085%, 3.240%, and 3.062% and nearby values remaining around 3.1-3.2%, safely below the 4.5% hard requirement. However, none of the available project documents or tools provide residual activation/dose-rate data, so the residual-dose hard requirement cannot be verified from the evidence available; activation sign-off is required before this can be considered fully qualified.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Simulation scan found Absorber-F3 to have the best resolution among candidates; best observed point was F3 at 5.4 mm with 3.085%, 3.240%, and 3.062% in repeated 100k-event runs. F1 best sampled value was 3.692% at 5.5 mm; F2 was >5% in sampled points.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F3, Absorber-F1, and Absorber-F2; selected option is Absorber-F3.

requirements.requirement: The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: For Absorber-F3 at 5.4 mm, repeated simulations returned 3.085%, 3.240%, and 3.062%, all better than 4.5%.

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: No residual dose-rate or activation data were present in candidate_specs.md, simulation_summary_2025.md, cooling.md, readout.md, meeting_notes_2026-05-14.md, or schedule.md, and the available simulation tool reports only energy resolution.
Selected plate thickness is 5.4 mm, within the allowed 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F3 with 5.4 mm plates.
